title: Add a live price ticker to the market view
description: Streams the latest price for a symbol into the market view and adds a small helper that smooths the displayed series. Ticker symbols and refresh intervals come from the new market config.

expected.note: The effect opens a price socket but never returns a cleanup function, so the stream is never closed. Every unmount and every `symbol` change leaves the old socket running, leaking subscriptions and stacking duplicate updates; return a cleanup that closes the socket.
The reducer subtracts each price from the running total instead of adding it, so the moving average is computed from a wrong (often negative) sum. The accumulator should be `sum + price`.
